verdict.rationale: LM Studio's core design as a local-first tool (local model downloads, offline chat, local REST API) inherently gives users control over data since nothing is sent to a remote server by default, but there is no explicit documentation or feature addressing data retention policies, chat history deletion, or configurable data lifecycle controls in the evidence pack. The closed-source nature and lack of transparency noted by community members ([lm-studio-comm-4], [lm-studio-comm-18]) further undercuts confidence in explicit retention/deletion controls beyond the implicit local-only architecture.
